subject.title: [Bug]: agents.list tools hot-reload not propagated to telegram channel workers — stale tool policy until full gateway restart (2026.7.1-2)

question: Should existing channel turns receive refreshed `agents.list[*].tools` policy during hot reload, or should this compatibility-sensitive policy remain restart-required with a clear gateway warning?
rationale: The report proposes both live propagation and restart-required behavior; choosing the permanent runtime contract requires maintainer intent after confirming the worker lifecycle and upgrade implications.

options.title: Propagate tool policy
options.body: Refresh the resolved per-agent policy in existing channel workers and add a regression test proving Telegram reflects the change without a restart.

options.title: Require restart explicitly
options.body: Classify tool-policy changes as restart-required and make the gateway report the pending stale-worker condition clearly.

recommendation.title: Propagate tool policy
recommendation.body: Refresh the resolved per-agent policy in existing channel workers and add a regression test proving Telegram reflects the change without a restart.

likelyOwner.reason: The only available history signal points to adjacent agent-scope behavior; direct ownership needs confirmation from repository history.
